c: Ophion summons stationary dark energy orbs with purple smoke and an
spinning in the middle. When it expires, it explodes and extends a bit beyond its normal area. Ophion has a higher Pool Limit, smaller
, and a small interval between each attack.
The orbs have a 1% chance to instantly kill an enemy just like a
, replacing the 50% chance to slow down enemies.

Ophion has a 1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every second by the same orb. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
